evidence: Original insertion 0x401D80 allocates the 0x1C circular entry and a 0x60 payload, installs vbtable 0x669430 with virtual owner at +0x58, and constructs the nested list at +0x2C. This is the same NetAllocationNode shape already established by Net construction at 0x62D763. Its one direct caller 0x630C30 maps DPSESSIONDESC2 name/GUID/flags/player counts/password into ledger inputs, supporting the new typed fields. The original list cleanup invokes the payload deleting destructor; the current NetAllocationNode implicit destructor still lacks the nested-list behavior. Existing Net teardown calls 0x401BE0 on node+0x48; that function begins by subtracting 0x1C to reach the nested-list start, not an unrelated eight-byte helper.
payload.hypothesis: Complete NetAllocationNode and its NetUnk72C nested-list destruction before replacing the ledger remove_all bridge with typed deletion. The ledger payload is the existing allocation-owning node, not a newly invented small session record; the same owner is embedded at Net+0x700. Move nested cleanup into its actual base/member chain without duplicating the manual operations currently in Net destruction or freeing individual Heap-owned allocations.
